description: Enter the first day of your last period to get a due date, current week, and trimester.

faqs.a: Add 280 days (40 weeks) to the first day of the last menstrual period — this is Naegele's rule.
faqs.q: How is the due date calculated?

faqs.a: Only about 4–5% of babies arrive exactly on the due date; most come within two weeks either side.
faqs.q: How accurate is the due date?

faqs.a: Weeks 1–13 are the first trimester, 14–27 the second, and 28–40 the third.

howto: Enter the first day of your last menstrual period.
See your estimated due date (LMP + 280 days).
